title: B2B Sales Executive
description:
B2 B Sales Executive Health and Wellness DTC Retailer SW London

Location: SW London / regular client meetings and pitches

Salary: Up to 35,000 base + UNCAPPED COMMISSION

Zachary Daniels are again delighted to be supporting one of the fastest growing wellness brands in the UK who are on a mission to help people move better, recover faster and feel stronger in their bodies.

A Sunday Times Top 10 fastest growing business, they are changing the way people recover, bringing world-class recovery technology out of elite sport and into everyday life. From F1, Olympic Athletes and Wimbledon Tennis to people simply wanting to feel and perform at their best, they are building products, experiences and spaces that make physical and mental recovery more accessible.

The Opportunity:

As the business continues to grow at a rapid rate they are now receiving a significant volume of inbound enquiries from gyms, hotels, sports clubs, wellness spaces and other businesses wanting to create dedicated branded recovery rooms and our client is looking for someone exceptionally hungry to take ownership of this opportunity.

This will not be a traditional sales role where you inherit a process and simply work through a pipeline. You will need to build it. This is a brand new role with infinite opportunity that for the right person will be a rocket ship!

As B2 B Sales Executive you will take ownership of their growing B2 B recovery-space channel: converting inbound opportunities, developing relationships, pitching the brand, closing deals and ultimately building a repeatable sales engine that can become a significant part of the business.

There are already leads coming in. Your job will be to turn them into revenue and then find more.

You will need to be commercially hungry, brilliant with people and relentless about getting things over the line.

This role will require someone to own their own sales pipeline, forecasting and reporting, whilst working closely with the wider team to ensure a brilliant experience from initial enquiry through to installation and identify opportunities to grow existing accounts.

This role is about building the playbook for this entire area of the business.

Who We're Looking For:
- You'll have a minimum of two years' experience in a B2 B sales role where you have delivered growth across a partnerships model - fitness, health and wellness, sports, property, recruitment industries would all be good fits.
- As a minimum you will have a passion and thirst for the Health and Wellness industry, ideally you will have worked within it in some capacity but more than anything you will bring the right personality, 'can-do' attitude and hunger to the role.
- You are naturally commercial and love closing.
- You get energy from speaking to people and building relationships.
- You are highly proactive and don't wait to be given a to-do list.
- Is comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where not everything has been figured out yet.
- You want your earning potential to be linked directly to the value they create.
- Is ambitious and wants the chance to build something, not simply step into something already built.

title: Business Development Executive - Debt Advisory
description:
Business Development Executive - Debt Advisory

Salary: £40,000 - £55,000 basic + commission + annual bonus + benefits

The Opportunity

We are working with a well-established professional services business that is continuing to grow its Debt Advisory offering. As part of this growth, they are looking to appoint an experienced and commercially driven Business Development Executive to join the team.

This is a relationship-led B2 B business development role, ideally suited to an individual with a proven track record of developing new business within Financial Services, Commercial Finance, Banking or a related professional services environment.

The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying and developing commercial opportunities, building relationships with key introducers and professional contacts, and contributing directly to the continued growth of the Debt Advisory division.

This is not a high-volume, transactional or telesales position. We are looking for someone who understands consultative B2 B sales, is comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders and has the commercial credibility to develop long-term relationships that generate opportunities.

The Role

As Business Development Executive, you will take an active role in developing the division's business development strategy and generating new revenue opportunities.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Identifying, developing and converting new business opportunities across the UK business finance market.
- Building and maintaining a strong network of introducers, professional advisers, lenders and business owners.
- Developing long-term, commercially valuable relationships with key stakeholders.
- Identifying opportunities through existing networks, referrals, networking and targeted business development activity.
- Managing and progressing a pipeline of prospective clients and introducers from initial engagement through to opportunity.
- Developing relationships with accountants, corporate finance professionals, IFAs, lawyers, lenders and other professional introducers.
- Attending and representing the business at networking events, conferences, client meetings and industry events.
- Working closely with senior members of the Debt Advisory team to develop opportunities and convert introductions into fee-generating business.
- Identifying cross-referral opportunities across the wider professional services business.
- Developing sector and market knowledge to identify new commercial opportunities.
- Supporting targeted campaigns and initiatives designed to raise the profile of the Debt Advisory offering.
- Contributing to LinkedIn, thought leadership, events, webinars and other profile-raising activity.
- Supporting the preparation of client proposals, presentations and introductory materials.
- Maintaining an accurate and commercially focused CRM and pipeline.
- Tracking business development activity, referral sources and opportunities.
- Contributing directly to the growth of the division and generation of fee income.

About You

We are looking for an experienced B2 B Business Development professional from Financial Services who can demonstrate a track record of developing relationships and generating commercial opportunities.

title: Hospitality Recruitment Sales Executive - Part-Time
description:
Hospitality Recruitment Sales Executive - Part-Time

Remote Choose Your Own UK Territory

£17.50 per hour + 10% commission + performance bonuses

10 hours per week initially, with potential to increase to around 15 hours

Freelance 12-month contract Initial 4-week paid performance review

E Junior Recruitment is looking for a confident, commercially minded Hospitality Recruitment Sales Executive to develop a new client base within one dedicated UK territory.

This is a genuine new-business role focused on identifying hospitality employers with recruitment needs and converting those opportunities into paid managed recruitment campaigns.

Choose your territory

The successful candidate will choose one region to own and develop:
- Greater London
- South East
- South West
- Midlands
- North East
- North West
- Yorkshire

You will not be expected to cover the entire country.

We want you to focus on your chosen territory, understand the hospitality businesses within it and progressively build your own client base and pipeline.

What will you be selling?

E Junior provides a managed recruitment campaign service to employers that need to recruit but don't necessarily have the time or internal recruitment resources to manage the complete process themselves.

Rather than simply introducing one candidate and charging a traditional agency placement fee, we can manage the recruitment campaign from beginning to end.

This can include:
- Vacancy briefing and campaign setup
- Advert creation
- Job-board advertising
- Application management
- Candidate screening
- Shortlisting
- Interview scheduling
- Candidate communication
- Offer management
- Collection of agreed onboarding information

The employer retains the final hiring decision.

Recruitment campaign delivery will be managed centrally by an experienced recruitment professional with previous hospitality recruitment experience.

Your focus is winning and developing the client relationship, not screening candidates yourself.

What you'll be doing
- Developing hospitality clients within your chosen territory
- Researching suitable prospective employers
- Making proactive outbound calls and other appropriate approaches
- Speaking with owners, managers and other hiring decision-makers
- Identifying current and upcoming vacancies
- Understanding recruitment challenges
- Introducing our managed recruitment campaign service
- Creating interest and professionally handling objections
- Following up prospective clients
- Converting opportunities into paid campaigns
- Maintaining relationships with clients you've introduced
- Identifying repeat recruitment opportunities
- Maintaining accurate records of activity and pipeline
- Attending a short weekly performance and pipeline review

Potential clients could include hotels, restaurants, pubs, hospitality groups and other suitable hospitality employers.

What we're looking for

Previous hospitality, recruitment or sales experience would be useful but is not essential.

We're more interested in your confidence, attitude, professionalism, organisation, resilience and ability to generate results independently.

You must be comfortable developing business from scratch.

There will be no established portfolio of clients or warm leads handed to you.

You should not require daily supervision or constant instruction on what to do next.

We'll provide the service, territory, support and expectations. We want someone confident enough to structure their working week, identify opportunities, follow prospects consistently and take responsibility for developing their pipeline.

Pay and commission

£17.50 per hour for 10 hours per week

plus

10% commission on service revenue generated from clients you win, subject to payment being received.

Additional performance bonuses will be available for consistently generating paid campaigns.

Strong performance could lead to additional hours, continued ownership of your territory and a longer-term opportunity as the service grows.

Initial performance review

The first four weeks will be fully paid.

We'll review progress using clear weekly activity and commercial KPIs, including:
- Prospecting activity
- Decision-maker conversations
- Qualified opportunities
- Pipeline development
- Paid recruitment campaigns
- Revenue generated

This is not a heavily supervised telesales role.

You'll have considerable freedom over how you develop your territory provided your activity is professional, properly recorded and producing measurable progress.

A short weekly review will cover results, pipeline, objections and next steps.

Why join?

You'll have the opportunity to build a hospitality recruitment sales territory from the beginning rather than inheriting someone else's desk.

Your role is to open doors, develop relationships and win business.

The recruitment service itself is delivered centrally, allowing you to remain focused on building your territory.

If you're confident that you can create opportunities from scratch and convert conversations into paying clients, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Sales Executive
description:
Sales Executive (Hospitality Recruitment)

Fully Remote Choose Your Own UK Territory

£17.50 per hour + 10% commission + performance bonuses

10 hours per week initially, with potential to increase to around 15 hours

Freelance 12-month contract Initial 4-week paid performance review

E Junior Recruitment is looking for a confident, commercially minded Hospitality Recruitment Sales Executive to develop a new client base within one dedicated UK territory.

This is a genuine new-business role focused on identifying hospitality employers with recruitment needs and converting those opportunities into paid managed recruitment campaigns.

Choose your territory

The successful candidate will choose one region to own and develop:
- Greater London
- South East
- South West
- Midlands
- North East
- North West
- Yorkshire

You will not be expected to cover the entire country.

We want you to focus on your chosen territory, understand the hospitality businesses within it and progressively build your own client base and pipeline.

What will you be selling?

E Junior provides a managed recruitment campaign service to employers that need to recruit but don't necessarily have the time or internal recruitment resources to manage the complete process themselves.

Rather than simply introducing one candidate and charging a traditional agency placement fee, we can manage the recruitment campaign from beginning to end.

This can include:
- Vacancy briefing and campaign setup
- Advert creation
- Job-board advertising
- Application management
- Candidate screening
- Shortlisting
- Interview scheduling
- Candidate communication
- Offer management
- Collection of agreed onboarding information

The employer retains the final hiring decision.

Recruitment campaign delivery will be managed centrally by an experienced recruitment professional with previous hospitality recruitment experience.

Your focus is winning and developing the client relationship, not screening candidates yourself.

What you'll be doing
- Developing hospitality clients within your chosen territory
- Researching suitable prospective employers
- Making proactive outbound calls and other appropriate approaches
- Speaking with owners, managers and other hiring decision-makers
- Identifying current and upcoming vacancies
- Understanding recruitment challenges
- Introducing our managed recruitment campaign service
- Creating interest and professionally handling objections
- Following up prospective clients
- Converting opportunities into paid campaigns
- Maintaining relationships with clients you've introduced
- Identifying repeat recruitment opportunities
- Maintaining accurate records of activity and pipeline
- Attending a short weekly performance and pipeline review

Potential clients could include hotels, restaurants, pubs, hospitality groups and other suitable hospitality employers.

What we're looking for

Previous hospitality, recruitment or sales experience would be useful but is not essential.

We're more interested in your confidence, attitude, professionalism, organisation, resilience and ability to generate results independently.

You must be comfortable developing business from scratch.

There will be no established portfolio of clients or warm leads handed to you.

You should not require daily supervision or constant instruction on what to do next.

We'll provide the service, territory, support and expectations. We want someone confident enough to structure their working week, identify opportunities, follow prospects consistently and take responsibility for developing their pipeline.

Pay and commission

£17.50 per hour for 10 hours per week

plus

10% commission on service revenue generated from clients you win, subject to payment being received.

Additional performance bonuses will be available for consistently generating paid campaigns.

Strong performance could lead to additional hours, continued ownership of your territory and a longer-term opportunity as the service grows.

Initial performance review

The first four weeks will be fully paid.

We'll review progress using clear weekly activity and commercial KPIs, including:
- Prospecting activity
- Decision-maker conversations
- Qualified opportunities
- Pipeline development
- Paid recruitment campaigns
- Revenue generated

This is not a heavily supervised telesales role.

You'll have considerable freedom over how you develop your territory provided your activity is professional, properly recorded and producing measurable progress.

A short weekly review will cover results, pipeline, objections and next steps.

Why join?

You'll have the opportunity to build a hospitality recruitment sales territory from the beginning rather than inheriting someone else's desk.

Your role is to open doors, develop relationships and win business.

The recruitment service itself is delivered centrally, allowing you to remain focused on building your territory.

If you're confident that you can create opportunities from scratch and convert conversations into paying clients, we'd like to hear from you.

As the UK Enterprise Account Executive, you'll be responsible for identifying, building and closing new business opportunities with enterprise organisations across the UK.
